name: Out-of-Core Sparse Voxel Octree Construction
definition: An algorithm that constructs a sparse voxel octree (SVO) from a triangle mesh while keeping memory usage logarithmic in the size of the SVO, by processing an intermediate high-resolution 3D voxel grid in Morton order in a streaming manner.
summary: Out-of-core sparse voxel octree construction builds an SVO from a triangle mesh using disk-based partitioning to ensure bounded memory usage for datasets exceeding main RAM.
